lines: : Detroit at Buffalo opens Week 2 on Friday 8:15am Perth, BUF -4.5, total 53.5, thunderstorms forecast. Both 1-0 after the Lions edged New Orleans 31-30 in OT.
Baltimore looks the AFC North measuring stick after 41-23 at Indianapolis. Lamar Jackson 17/25, 324 yds, Derrick Henry 24 car, 144 yds, 3 TD. Next up Saints at home, BAL -8.5.
Chicago put 59 on Carolina in a 59-37 game, then hosts Minnesota as a 5.5-point favourite. Vikings beat Green Bay 39-22. Total 49.5.
Pittsburgh won 20-13 over Atlanta but is a 5.5-point road dog at New England in Week 2. Rain, total 42.5. Market is not buying the Steelers yet.
Kansas City handled Denver 31-10, Kenneth Walker III 23 car, 173 yds, 1 TD. Colts visit Arrowhead Sunday night, KC -6.5.
San Francisco is SF -13.5 at home against Miami after beating the Rams 27-7 in Melbourne. Raiders beat Miami 27-13 in Week 1.

postgame.what_decided_it: Turnovers. Tampa lost four fumbles and Cincinnati scored a defensive touchdown. The Bengals also won the possession battle 31:25 to 28:35 and went 8-14 on third down.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 25/35, 254 yds, 1 TD, 1 INT. Efficient, not spectacular, 6.8 yards per pass.
Mike Gesicki: 5 rec, 78 yds, 1 TD. Team high in receiving.
Chase Brown: 16 car, 56 yds, 1 TD in a 106-yard rushing day.
postgame.division_meaning: Three-way tie at the top. Baltimore 1-0 at +18, Cincinnati 1-0 at +6, Pittsburgh 1-0 at +7. Cleveland is 0-1 at -24 after losing 34-10 at Jacksonville.
postgame.the_take: Four forced fumbles is not a repeatable plan. Cincinnati only out-gained Tampa 351 to 282 and went 2-5 in the red zone. Clean that up or Houston is a problem.
